name: StepGuide
description: Step-by-step instructions for using a device or doing a task with things (making coffee, printing, fixing), listed once. Not for exercises or moving the body (that is LiveCoach).
examples: How do I use the espresso machine?
How do I print a poster?
How do I reset the router?
note: Foundational MOD defined as a spec (modos-system-design.md 5.3): the system can choose it and its text answers; its selectors and representations are not implemented yet.

default.label: Steps beside the device
default.description: Step-by-step instructions for using a device or doing a task, listed once (not tracked step by step).
